title: 第三十章 砸场子去
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
秦弦答应之后就隐隐后悔了。

    且不说他现在就是个活靶子，带上毫无益处只有拖累，就是带他出极乐馆，也不是件容易的事。

    邵馆主是同三教九流周旋多年的老江湖，想从他手里要人，只怕不易。

    “大小姐，您的心意秦弦心领，只是邵馆主他实在是……”

    萧姚满不在乎地摆摆手：

    “怎么着，

    当时我以为凭我的努力，我一定能守住妻子，可现在的事实显得非常可笑。

    荣寿宫虽是正一品太妃的宫宇，但是僖贵太妃性情淡泊，常年礼佛，荣寿宫自然也就看着萧瑟一些。

    骤然起了一阵风，朦儿拿出早前备好的五彩绣金缎面披风给幼薇披上了。

    陆枫的心情是可以理解的，可是为了保护妻子，我不想陆婉出面。
content_en:
Qin Xian faintly regretted it after agreeing.

Not to mention that he is now a living target, bringing him with him will be of no benefit but only a drag. Even taking him out of the Paradise Hall is not an easy task.

The master of the Shao Hall is an old Jianghu who has been dealing with the three religions and nine schools for many years. If you want to get people from him, it will be difficult.

"Miss, Qin Xian understands your thoughts, but Master Shao is really..."

Xiao Yao waved his hand nonchalantly:

"What's the matter?

At that time, I thought that with my hard work, I would be able to keep my wife, but the facts now seem very ridiculous.

Although Rongshou Palace is the palace of a first-class concubine, Princess Xi Gui has an indifferent temperament and worships Buddha all the year round, so Rongshou Palace naturally looks a little bleak.

Suddenly there was a gust of wind, and Meng'er took out the colorful embroidered gold satin cloak that she had prepared earlier and put it on Youwei.

Lu Feng's mood is understandable, but in order to protect his wife, I don't want Lu Wan to come forward.
